scope: steps123 successor: shared function interface and minimal fixed source roles; no stage4 admission
source_roles: see explicit immutable source groups, all target/stage/repeat variants inherit role
grouping: canonical complete producer/consumer/capture bit graph; all periods, stages and repeats of that source stay in one role; no seed-based duplicates across roles
role_exclusions: old diagnostic/reference/consumed-test rows remain excluded; software functional vectors are not physical training/test labels

baselines: Ridge with semantic width/load features and numerical T

segmented_Ridge.knots: pooled train-only target quantiles; validation chooses candidate

operator_candidates.width_policy: compare shared model first; optional operand-width groups selected with validation; each group needs >=3 train and >=2 validation source groups, else uncovered
operator_candidates.selection: quality-passing validation candidate with smallest source-macro normalized absolute error, then complexity and stable declared order
prohibited: case or NodeId or whole-graph hash as features

quality.status: new preregistered thresholds; not retroactive to old models

delay_and_area_relative_error.quantile: nearest-rank over per-source median relative errors

absolute_error_floors.role: relative denominator max(abs(label), floor); also report raw MAE

quality.validation_delay_reserve: max(0, worst validation source/target delay underprediction) in ps per qualified operation/width group, frozen before test; no duplicate reserve in S/G
quality.coverage: mandatory required-domain inventory, three-region counts/spans/shortfalls, held-out source/context errors and actual new-target interpolation coverage; no domain inferred from independent min/max alone
quality.independent_target_interpolation: role-specific initial targets preregistered in sampler; after collection report which test targets are unmeasured in fit and within supported train range; require at least one such point per claimed operation; no substitution after test
quality.full_stage_false_feasible_scope: future joint stage gate including all owners/IO/reserves, never compare bare operator delay with T as full feasibility
quality.conservative_rejection: report separately; validation selects reserve, locked_test never changes it

capacity.status: finite diagnostic qualification complete; formal source/target admission still separate
capacity.measured_plan: steps123 evidence capacity-plan.json; measurements do not qualify arbitrary tighter targets

S_G_order: software interleaved; formal residuals and independent evaluation retain frozen dependencies

feature_schema.exclusion_reason: price models use canonical demanded precision; declaration-only padding remains in semantic certificates; upstream correlation/longer topology require G checks

measurement_boundary.capture: unconditional, separately observable FF bank adapter
measurement_boundary.launch: registered data with explicit valid/enable/reset protocol
measurement_boundary.native_S_G_note: actual native enable/reset/capture loading does not automatically inherit this local measurement scope; explicit S/G joint-domain validation required
measurement_boundary.native_padding_note: declaration-only padding is not a learned extrapolation input; validate canonicalization/implementation effects in real composition before production pricing

function_support: semantic operation/width/result/mask/load rules and source-neighbor support selected with validation, frozen before test; no shape-ID price table
reserved_generalization: unseen low result and known-bit pattern
new exact target within supported training interval

static_ablation.scope: same views/T/L/II/search/ranking; only cost function or explicitly dependency-complete cost package differs
static_ablation.delay_unit_bridge: single nonnegative global alpha_d from source-equal train least squares through origin on fixed delay proxy
static_ablation.area_unit_bridge: single nonnegative global alpha_A from source-equal train least squares through origin on fixed area proxy
static_ablation.G: prefer common zero correction; never transplant base-dependent residual between models

collection_execution.persistent_artifact_destination_and_rest: required by batch storage protocol; not yet selected
